brief_md:
The most significant development in the last 24 hours is related to public safety concerns, specifically the ongoing situation in Ukraine. Reports indicate that Ukrainian forces have targeted Russian energy infrastructure but denied any strikes on a Kremlin-occupied nuclear plant (Tribune-Seymour). Additionally, Eric Cole has secured another chance at his first PGA Tour win after posting an impressive 63 in the third round of the Colonial tournament (Tribune-Seymour).

In terms of civic and government matters, there are no major developments within Jackson County. However, it is worth noting that Donald Trump has announced he will headline the 'Great American State Fair' following the withdrawal of artists due to political ties concerns (Tribune-Seymour). This event could draw significant attention from local residents.

The health sector saw a notable update with Frankie Valli canceling the remainder of the Four Seasons’ farewell tour, citing personal health issues (Tribune-Seymour). While this is a significant event for music fans, it does not directly impact Jackson County's residents. 

No major developments were reported in the business category.
